name: Mini StealthBurner
description: Voron Design's official compact toolhead for the Voron V0.2. Features a low-mass direct-drive extruder using BMG gears and a 20mm pancake motor, with improved part cooling ducts optimized for the smaller Voron Zero platform.
features: Low-mass direct-drive design with BMG gears
20mm pancake NEMA14 motor with 10-tooth spur gear
Improved part cooling ducts over V0.1 toolhead
Compact form factor for Voron Zero platform
